artifact.name: go-cask object browser
artifact.purpose: Browse, filter, sort, page, and inspect content-addressed objects.
constraints: One flat operational workspace, not a dashboard.
Use live derived state from one normalized object collection.
When no object is selected, show no inspector values.
Use real button controls for tabs and actions.
Status is a real table column rendered as a compact semantic pill, not an absent value.

geometry.rowPadding: 8px horizontal and vertical; header row 7px vertical

content: 20x20 rounded fg square brand mark CA
Verify solid accent button aligned right

overflow.tableWrap: both axes; sticky header; bg token shows on unused scroll surface

mobile.workspace: one column; list first then inspector; workspace height auto with min-height calc(100vh - 93px)

search.leftIcon: ⌕ glyph, muted, 19.8px, absolutely positioned left 9px, vertically centered, pointer-events none
search.rightAction: × clear button appears only when query is non-empty; clears only query, refocuses search, retains other filters

reset.hover: 12% accent mixed into surface with 4px radius

objectTable.style: fixed-layout table-layout, dense, min-width 700px, mono data; unused scroll surface uses bg token; cells nowrap with ellipsis overflow

columns.label: Hash
columns.display: full sha256: prefix + first 8 hex chars, then ellipsis

columns.label: Status
columns.display: semantic pill, capitalized via text-transform, inserted as a real cell between Refs and Written

header.sortControl: one arrow button immediately right of label; active column shows ▲ ascending or ▼ descending; click toggles direction; selecting a different column starts ascending; aria-sort on the th and aria-pressed on the button

rows.selected: rowSelected with 2px dark leading inset (55% fg)
rows.click: select object and update inspector; Enter or Space selects the focused row
rows.hashDisplay: first 15 characters of full hash followed by ellipsis (keeps full sha256: prefix)

objectTable.empty: One centered row spanning all six columns: No objects match the current filters.

statusLabels.shape: compact borderless 3px-radius pill, min-height 19px, 700 10px text, text-transform capitalize

pagination.placement: bottom of object list, pinned below table scroll area, bg surface, 7px 14px
pagination.control: 27px bordered square, mono 12.1px; disabled unavailable controls at 0.4 opacity and not-allowed cursor

verifyButton.default: solid accent fill, surface text, height 28px, radius 4px, 12.1px 650
verifyButton.hover: accent darkened toward fg (86% accent mix) for fill and border
verifyButton.working: disabled at 0.6 opacity with wait cursor, label Verifying…
verifyButton.done: brief Verified state, restores to Verify after 1.2s

splitter.role: vertical drag separator, role=separator, aria-orientation vertical, min 280 max 560
splitter.drag: pointer events change inspector width within 280px to 560px; width stored as CSS var --inspector-width and aria-valuenow
splitter.keyboard: Left/Right steps 20px; Home sets min; End sets max
splitter.visible: 4px border tone; accent on hover or drag

header.label: Object, micro uppercase mono heading
header.hash: full selected hash in mono, wraps anywhere
header.copy: 25px bordered icon button visible only when hash exists; ⧉ default, ✓ for 1.2s on success; aria-label Copy full object hash then Hash copied
header.back: compact button, disabled until an object was opened from a reference; restores the preceding inspector selection

tabs.implementation: button tablist with arrow-key navigation (Left/Right/Home/End), aria-selected and tabindex roving, exactly one active panel
tabs.active: foreground text, 650 weight, 2px accent bottom border

metadata.layout: two-column definition list, label column 96px, value flexible left aligned; section margin 20px
metadata.timestamp: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with milliseconds: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ
metadata.status: current point-in-time verification result rendered as a semantic status pill
metadata.empty: Keep headings and property labels, clear all values

references.row: direction arrow, uppercase reference-kind pill, shortened hash; mono
references.outEmpty: This object references no other objects.
references.empty: Show no reference items when no object is selected

bytes.content: first 128 object bytes as eight rows of offset, 16 hex bytes, and ASCII; rendered from a deterministic hex preview
bytes.empty: No content when no object is selected

object.hash: full content address string with sha256: prefix
object.size: human byte string (B/KiB/MiB); derive byte count for comparison separately
object.writtenAt: epoch timestamp used for sort and RFC 3339 derivation
object.written: human readable timestamp or age (h ago / d ago)
object.verificationResult: ephemeral result in a session map, initially unverified; Verify marks refsBy above zero verified and refsBy zero orphaned

rules: Filtering or changing page size resets to page 1.
Filter the normalized object collection, sort it, then take the current page slice.

Size comparisons use integer bytes parsed from the display string; Written comparisons use writtenAt timestamps; Refs comparisons use integers; Hash, Type, and Status use locale-aware text comparison.
Verify updates the current session verification result for all objects: refsBy above zero becomes verified, refsBy zero becomes orphaned.
Unverified and Corrupt filters are available; no objects match until corresponding verification results exist.
Total size in pagination equals the sum of all currently matched object byte sizes, not just the current page.
No matches clears selection and every inspector value, reference list, byte row, and copy action.
When matches exist and the selected object is not in the filtered result set, select the first matching object and update inspector data.
Any selected row visually reflects selection with a leading inset and updates inspector data.
Status cells are inserted between the Refs and Written columns after initial row build.
Do not render an unbounded result list; paginate before DOM/server response rendering.

accessibility.focus: 2px accent ring on all focusable controls; inputs/selects use 2px offset, compact row controls use 1px offset
accessibility.table: Expose column headers, aria-sort state, semantic status-label text, and selected row state; rows are keyboard focusable with Enter/Space selection
accessibility.tabs: Use button controls with tab role, aria-selected state, associated panels, and arrow-key roving navigation
accessibility.splitter: Expose separator role and vertical orientation with aria-valuenow and keyboard resizing (arrows, Home, End)
accessibility.copy: Accessible name must state Copy full object hash and change to Hash copied for confirmation

implementationGuidance.client: Use one deterministic 512-object store and derive view state. Avoid duplicate fallback DOM or stale handlers. Treat verification results as session state, not intrinsic object data.
implementationGuidance.server: Represent query, filters, sort, page, page size, selected hash, and active tab in the URL. Return the table and pager as one fragment and inspector as a selected-object fragment.
implementationGuidance.portability: This document specifies behavior and styling independently of framework. It can be implemented with SSR templates, htmx, React, native desktop, or another UI technology.
